title: data_publish step configuration (architecture section 4)
description: Publication mode: all or nothing (architecture section 4's translator semantics). 'atomic' republishes the whole relation behind one swap; 'incremental' republishes only the rows the run produced, keyed by 'unique_key', which that mode requires (ergasterion/framework/declaration.py enforces the pairing). Named 'publication_mode', deliberately not 'mode' -- that bare token is reserved by the estate's expression-mode policy and is never a legal key in any step or product-level object (architecture section 3.2: the mode is estate policy only, never a per-product or per-column choice).
